## CORE RULE 7. Don't misuse, abuse or ignore admin messages.
Admin help, or "ahelp", is the system used to open a chat in order to communicate with admins and for them to reach out to specific players in the game, usually regarding rules.
\n [bold]Appropriate uses of ahelp[/bold] - Whenever you have reasons to believe a player might be breaking a rule. Even if it turns out to be a non-issue it’s best to let an admin know about it. Don’t worry about wasting anyone’s time. - If you are wondering whether something would be against rules, or in special circumstances asking for temporary exemption from a rule. - To ask for help with handling unintended game/server issues, or asking for an antag token if your antagonist round was ruined by game/server issues.
\n [bold]Misuse[/bold] [color=indianred](minor)[/color] - Don’t message admins in ahelp over things that do not require admin attention, such as asking for in-round advantages or to get entertainment. (IC methods of contacting admins, like prayers, faxes, red phones, and banana phones, should be used when there is not an issue. In some cases, OOC/LOOC or dead chat.) - Don’t make uninformative attempts to trigger a response, such as "hello" or asking if an admin is present without elaborating further. Admins need to understand what the ahelp is about before they can respond, and every message is automatically relayed through discord.
\n [bold]Abuse[/bold] [color=indianred](major)[/color] - Don’t break rules in ahelp. - Don’t spam the ahelp chat. - Don’t be aggressive, hostile or offensive towards admins.
\n [bold]Evasion[/bold] [color=indianred](major)[/color] - Never lie to admins in ahelp. - Don’t continue to repeat the same behavior when an admin has warned you to stop. - Never ignore messages admins sent to you via ahelp, or disconnect during an ahelp. If you need to urgently leave make sure to establish contact on discord so it may be continued.
